name: Personalized Leather Badge Holder with Acrylic Beaded Lanyard and Acrylic Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality leather, acrylic, and a beaded lanyard, combining practicality with a fun and personalized decorative style.
    - The leather badge holder is designed in a vertical format, offering a clean and professional look for daily use.
    - Includes a durable acrylic charm made from 3 acrylic layers, each 3mm thick, for a total thickness of 9mm.
    - Paired with a comfortable lanyard for easy everyday wear around the neck.
    - The acrylic charm adds a playful decorative touch while enhancing the personalized look of the badge holder.
    - Designed to combine function, comfort, and cheerful custom styling in one accessory set.
    - Available in 16 beaded accessory styles.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Lanyard Length: 42.3 cm ~ 16.65 in
    - Leather badge holder size: 7 x 0.5 cm ~ 2.8 x 4 in
    - Charm size: 1 x 1 in ~ 2.54 x 2.54 cm
    📌 Note: The acrylic charm size may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed. The shape of the leather badge holder is fixed and cannot be changed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a badge holder and a personalized decorative everyday accessory.
    - Designed for holding ID cards, work badges, school IDs, event passes, and name cards.
    - The vertical leather badge holder keeps the card protected while maintaining a neat and professional appearance.
    - The lanyard allows convenient hands-free carrying for work, school, meetings, and events.
    - The acrylic charm and bead accessory help make the badge holder more fun, stylish, and personalized.
    - Suitable for teachers, students, office staff, healthcare workers, event staff, and anyone who wears an ID daily.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for teachers, students, coworkers, office staff, nurses, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Teacher Appreciation Day, back-to-school gifts, birthdays, holidays, staff gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who uses an ID badge and loves cute personalized accessories.
    - Great for school use, office use, classroom gifts, event accessories, and everyday work essentials.
    - A stylish and practical gift that combines daily function with a fun custom touch.
    - Adds a bright, cheerful, and memorable touch to everyday wear 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Personalized Leather Badge Holder with Acrylic Beaded Lanyard and Acrylic Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
